request: I already have my ticket. Can I add a window seat now?
answer: You cannot add a window seat to your existing ticket. Window seats can only be reserved at the time of booking for an extra Rs 40.
task_outputs: You cannot add a window seat to your existing ticket. Window seats can only be reserved at the time of booking for an extra Rs 40.
